key_icons: A flat black keypad: each digit with its small letters to its right, a thin grey line under each key. The 1 key also shows a small envelope and voicemail icon; the 3, 6 and 9 keys also show a small shortcut icon at their right end; the * key also shows a/A; the 0 key also shows '+'; the # key also shows a space symbol, a small silent (crossed note) symbol and a small icon at its right end.
